## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue if applicable.

## Validation

List relevant checks and their results. Include fixture screenshots for UI changes.
Describe any limitations in the evidence.

## Data and licensing

Confirm that examples use synthetic data and include no credentials or private
conversations. Identify any new third-party code, assets or dependencies and their
licenses. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/backrunner/memstation/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
